Media hall monitors upset that Daily Signal editor given pool duties on vice president's flight
Brett T.
|
9:48 PM on August 05, 2020
Advertisement
Vice President Mike Pence flew on Air Force Two to Florida on Wednesday, where he visited a women’s health clinic that promotes alternatives to abortion and spoke at a church. The man who was given a seat on Air Force Two to cover the flight for the press pool was Daily Signal executive editor Robert Bluey, which caused quite a commotion among the media’s hall monitors.
